answer: A forecast bond judged at the horizon: a newcomer posts 5 POA and forecasts its first job will pass the jury, the forecast sealed on a public nebula ledger and carried to the jury by a sparrow courier; a failed forecast slashes the bond, set at 5 POA times the square of the newcomer's position among identities from one wallet — 1st fake 5, 10th 500, 1,925 across ten; copied work fails, so each clone pays more for the same lie.
